show.description: After years away, Siddharth Menon returns to his village as a man everyone believes is a failure — unaware that he is now the secret owner of a global corporate empire. As betrayal, greed, and corruption threaten the people who once saved his life, Siddharth hides his true identity while fighting to protect them from within. In a world where truth is mocked and power is disguised; one man quietly becomes their ultimate protector.
